reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

rules.native_fields: Source full native/current meaning and proportional-method choice bearer; target proposition, guard, criterion, cheaper alternative and cost, plus the authored concrete route. Complete native/profile/evidence dependencies remain authoritative.
rules.shared_question: Does this particular formal activity add a sufficient discriminator for the receiving native predicate at proportionate total burden?
rules.guard: The member names the actual receiving predicate and a specific possible representation/checking activity for it. The relation is the neutral prospective choice about that activity; it does not assert execution or deployment. An unrelated application, a text encoding or merely shared cost vocabulary is outside membership. The source criterion applies only when this activity is genuinely under consideration for the named uncertainty.
rules.member_correspondence: All109 routes were explicitly authored from the complete selected meanings. Each names a predicate, concrete formal activity, adequate simpler comparator and residual premises. The binding appends exact native/current pointers and literal receiver clauses. The rule membership is this explicit table, not a generated title/category range.
rules.counterfactual: Hold the native predicate fixed. If the existing direct method already resolves it, the new formal work adds burden without a discriminator; if a specified boundary/interleaving/calculation remains unresolved, a supported narrow check may add one. That difference changes the native adequacy/cost choice. It does not require either choice to win universally.
rules.remaining_premises: The proposed method must support the actual property; its result and any model/world, implementation, sampling or physical premises must be established before application credit. Cost, consequences, available expertise and nontradeable constraints are not supplied by a method name.
rules.authority_effect_boundary: A method-selection judgment neither grants operating/maintenance authority nor causes a restoration, physical action or empirical improvement.
rules.nontrigger: No such formal activity is under consideration; the question is unrelated to the named predicate; the offered artifact only encodes text; or existing adequate evidence leaves no consequential unresolved distinction. No extra control is then required.
rules.source_ceiling: Analytical prospective evaluation grounded in native/current meanings and specific constructed choice routes. No measured universal return on investment, actual execution of all109 methods, field efficacy, independence or new property identity is claimed.
rules.subsumption: The choice criteria overlap with R038 and the receivers own cost/cheap-path clauses. A material interpretation or evaluation input can be redundant or already subsumed; it is not automatically a novel mechanism.
rules.reverse: No D/R-to-F037 or F042 direction is assigned by these rules; each reverse needs its own actual input to the formal-method choice.
rules.reentry: A changed required predicate, method semantics, residual uncertainty, cheaper alternative, hard constraint, current artifact or total burden reopens the affected comparison. A new use needs its own correspondence.
rules.title: Selective representation/checking for the exact predicate
rules.source_contribution: F037 supplies the choice among a focused language/model/analysis/composition check, an ordinary method and no added control. It changes which scope of formal effort can resolve the member predicate without demanding total-system proof.
rules.common_inference: Compare the named predicate and actual unresolved distinction against the specific activity and cheaper alternative. Retain a narrow useful result when wider premises remain; reject excessive or irrelevant formalization.

challenges.test: Replace the erasure/interleaving check with a proof of f(f(x))=f(x).
challenges.result: The substitute can miss A:set1;B:set2;retryA:set1. The route retains the actual admitted-history predicate; a fixed isolated assignment remains a positive cheaper control.

challenges.test: Treat a proved renewal/stress/hazard/handbook calculation as validated physical mechanism or provenance.
challenges.result: Rejected. The route only checks the actual mathematical subclaim. Physical renewal, mode stability, data provenance and transfer remain explicit residuals; a bounded empirical/comparative statement can be adequate.
challenges.basis: Full current native qualifications; received constituent cases; SYN-S05

challenges.test: Add repeated monitors/formal checks until their individual local benefits look strong.
challenges.result: NX06 shows shared error and accumulated load can defeat the service; one removal may leave overload and bounded backlog need not drain. Total burden and a sufficient one-time local check must be compared.

challenges.test: Replace actual maintenance capability with a proved procedure/prerequisite ordering.
challenges.result: Rejected. A valid sequence is a partial design input; human competence, physical access, stock, authority and actual service window remain. A tested concise procedure can be the adequate lower-burden choice.

challenges.test: Choose a numerically cheaper forbidden action or silently relax a protected service requirement.
challenges.result: Rejected. Authority and hard constraints delimit feasible alternatives before any cost comparison. The method cannot supply stakeholder values.
challenges.basis: NX01; received r2 loss model limits; native decision roles

challenges.test: Require a new minimal proof, full rerun or active owner merely because evidence is old or stronger than needed.
challenges.result: Rejected. Compatible unchanged evidence and an amortized stronger service can be adequate; inactive archival value is retained. Material premise change alone triggers the affected recheck.

challenges.test: Substitute type-correct encoding of the property text for checking the actual event, exposure or arithmetic predicate.
challenges.result: NX02 keeps identical text in opposite functional worlds. The routes instead name an actual functional/arithmetical discriminator; correct arithmetic still leaves empirical event labels and sampling open.

challenges.test: Demand deployment, probability calibration or a second test before crediting an exact conditional theorem.
challenges.result: Rejected. A model theorem can be the complete intended object. Extra evidence is justified only for a distinct application premise or consumer decision.
challenges.basis: NX07; received fault-budget constructions; native model-only controls
